versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No other functional or documentation changes in this version.

- Initial release of HackerNews数据服务 skill.
- Provides HackerNews search, retrieval, and analysis via Model Context Protocol.
- Supports searching stories, comments, and users with filters and advanced logic.
- Allows fetching front page, latest posts, item details (including comments), and user profiles.
- Requires configuration of an API key (XBY_APIKEY) for use. Missing keys will prompt user input.
- Includes user-friendly, step-by-step instructions and structured workflow for tool integration.
